name: Room Change for Council Meeting on June 23, 2026 Memo
agenda_text:
The City of San Diego
Office of Council President Joe LaCava
First District
M e m o r a n d u m
date: June 23, 2026
to: Honorable City Councilmembers
from: Council President Joe LaCava, District 1
subject: Room Change for Council Meeting on June 23, 2026
______________________________________________________________________________________________
Due to emergent technical issues, the San Diego City Council meeting of Tuesday, June 23, 2026, has been moved to the adjacent Committee Room, on the 12 th Floor of the City Administration Building, at 202 C Street, San Diego, California, 92101. All other operations remain as regular.
cc: Honorable Mayor Todd Gloria
Honorable City Attorney Heather Ferbert
Diana Fuentes, City Clerk
Charles Modica, Independent Budget Analyst
